features.name: any_comment_specific_real_world_example
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment offer a specific real-world example as support?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment, in its own words, cites a specific real-world example (a concrete named or identifiable real event, case, person, organization, place, study or personal real experience) as support for its argument. Return 0 if no comment does (generic claims, hypotheticals, and purely abstract reasoning do not count). An external source cited as support counts. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates or reports of the outcome as evidence. Generic platform-rule discussion is eligible. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.

h0: any_comment_specific_real_world_example has no association with the probability of OP view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with any_comment_specific_real_world_example = 1 have a higher probability of OP view change than those with 0.
note: Presence is binary per the unspecified 'containing'. OLS on the binary outcome is a linear probability model; association only, not causal. Comments are unordered with unknown timing, and OC_comments may contain outcome announcements, which the prompt excludes as evidence. "Specific" is judged by the annotator under the stated criterion.
